name: Sylvie In The Rain
source:
It's a cold, rainy day and a ghost just invited you to sit and have a drink. Sometimes it's nice to sit next to a warm fire, with someone to listen to your troubles.

[From [url=https://talamack.itch.io/sylvie-in-the-rain]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是个寒冷的雨天，一位幽灵邀请你坐在炉火旁喝一杯。有时，能依偎着温暖的火焰，身边还有人愿意倾听烦恼，感觉真好。

[来源：[url=https://talamack.itch.io/sylvie-in-the-rain]Itch.io[/url]]
